English Proficiency Examination
International graduate applicants must demonstrate English-language proficiency by submitting either Duolingo, TOEFL or IELTS scores.
Please Note: We encourage you to confirm, with your department, their TOEFL/IELTS score expectations.
Baylor's TOEFL Institution Code: 6032
For IELTS send to: Graduate Admissions, Baylor University, One Bear Place #97264, Waco, TX 76798-7264.
We accept electronic or paper delivery for both tests.
Minimum Scores
Duolingo
Program Minimum Score
All Programs 125
TOEFL
Method Minimum Score
Master's Degree 4.0
Professional Doctorates 4.0
PhD Research Doctorates 4.5
IELTS
Program Minimum Score
Business 7.0
All others 6.5
*Duolingo, TOEFL and IELTS scores are valid for 2 years.
Exemptions
If you meet one of the following requirements and have already uploaded your transcript(s) to your application file, you may request an exemption by emailing GraduateAdmissions@baylor.edu.
International applicants are exempt from the TOEFL/IELTS requirement under the following circumstances:
You have a conferred bachelor's (or higher) degree from an accredited institution in the United States.
You have a conferred bachelor's (or higher) degree from an institution where English is the only language of instruction.
You are a U.S. citizen or permanent resident (this includes Puerto Rico).
